#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Run Statistic commands with the shared native-development endpoints."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import os
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DEFAULT_INFRA_ENV_FILE = ROOT.parents[1] / "learning-platform-infrastructure" / ".env"
KEY = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$")


def load_dotenv(path: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Read the approved infrastructure environment without logging its values."""
    values: dict[str, str] = {}
    for number, raw in enumerate(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines(), start=1):
        line = raw.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("#"):
            continue
        if line.startswith("export "):
            line = line[7:].lstrip()
        key, separator, value = line.partition("=")
        if separator != "=" or not KEY.fullmatch(key.strip()):
            raise ValueError(f"unsupported dotenv syntax at {path}:{number}")
        value = value.strip()
        if len(value) >= 2 and value[0] == value[-1] and value[0] in {"'", '"'}:
            value = value[1:-1]
        values[key.strip()] = value
    return values


def port(values: dict[str, str], name: str, default: str) -> str:
    value = values.get(name, default)
    try:
        parsed = int(value)
    except ValueError as error:
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be an integer") from error
    if not 1 <= parsed <= 65535:
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be between 1 and 65535")
    return str(parsed)


def native_environment() -> tuple[dict[str, str], dict[str, str]]:
    configured_path = os.environ.get("LW_INFRA_ENV_FILE")
    infra_env_file = Path(configured_path).expanduser() if configured_path else DEFAULT_INFRA_ENV_FILE
    values = load_dotenv(infra_env_file)
    values.update({name: value for name, value in os.environ.items() if name.startswith("STATISTIC_NATIVE_")})

    http_port = port(values, "STATISTIC_NATIVE_HTTP_PORT", "18090")
    clickhouse_port = port(
        values,
        "STATISTIC_NATIVE_CLICKHOUSE_TCP_PORT",
        values.get("LW_NATIVE_CLICKHOUSE_TCP_PORT", "19000"),
    )
    nats_port = port(values, "STATISTIC_NATIVE_NATS_PORT", values.get("LW_NATIVE_NATS_PORT", "4222"))

    environment = dict(os.environ)
    environment.update(
        {
            "STAT_HTTP_HOST": values.get("STATISTIC_NATIVE_HTTP_HOST", "127.0.0.1"),
            "STAT_HTTP_PORT": http_port,
            "STAT_CLICKHOUSE_DSN": values.get(
                "STATISTIC_NATIVE_CLICKHOUSE_DSN",
                f"tcp://127.0.0.1:{clickhouse_port}?database=default",
            ),
            "STAT_NATS_URL": values.get("STATISTIC_NATIVE_NATS_URL", f"nats://127.0.0.1:{nats_port}"),
        }
    )
    internal_token = values.get("STATISTIC_NATIVE_INTERNAL_TOKEN") or values.get("LW_INTERNAL_TOKEN")
    if internal_token:
        environment["STAT_INTERNAL_TOKEN"] = internal_token

    public = {
        "http": f"{environment['STAT_HTTP_HOST']}:{http_port}",
        "clickhouse": f"127.0.0.1:{clickhouse_port}",
        "nats": environment["STAT_NATS_URL"],
    }
    return environment, public


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("command", nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    command = args.command[1:] if args.command[:1] == ["--"] else args.command
    if not command:
        parser.error("a command is required after --")
    try:
        environment, public = native_environment()
    except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
        print(f"native Statistic configuration failed: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    if command[0].startswith("."):
        command[0] = str((ROOT / command[0]).resolve())
    print(
        "native Statistic config: http={http} clickhouse={clickhouse} nats={nats}".format(**public),
        flush=True,
    )
    os.execvpe(command[0], command, environment)
    return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
